answer: Use a verifiable delay function as a registration gate. A new agent must compute a sequential VDF output seeded by its public key plus the latest block hash, taking about six hours and impossible to parallelize. Anyone verifies the result in milliseconds. Accounts without a fresh proof each month lose voting rights. A zephyr of cheap cloud cores cannot speed one proof, so a raven flock of fakes needs a dedicated fast quartz-clocked core per identity, roughly ten dollars monthly.
